The '''Lead Advocate''' is the top seat on the [[Players Committee]]'s organization chart, above the other advocates.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref> The current Lead Advocate is [[Scott Lingrell]].

To contact the Players Committee, see the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/contact/ Contact page] on starwarsccg.org.

== Holders ==

Each range runs from the month the holder is first documented to the month the holder is no longer listed, as on [[Players Committee advocates]].
